    Two-sided segments, crown rows and nondeep boundary arrows #

    lem:two-sided-factor-paths, lem:crown-output-comparison and lem:nondeep-boundary-arrows, in path-free form: an ordinary path is recorded by its first (last) arrow, an ordinary left (right) divisor.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.

    def LargeIndecomposable.RaySys.Sys.CrownRow {V R L : Type} [AddCommGroup L] (S : Sys V R L) (χ : L) (a b f : R) :
    Prop

    A row X_a + Y_b = [f] with generating two-sided output (eq:generating-crown-row): f = a v = w b with v right-sided and w left-sided generating, b the last arrow of v and a the first arrow of w.
